details.gpu_style: user-image compact single-fan dual-slot card; fan faces perforated side panel and dual-slot bracket faces rear service panel
details.psu: compact 1U/Flex 160 x 80 x 40 mm, mounted directly to the screw-fixed rear panel; no internal cradle; model-specific holes are a post-selection fabrication adaptation excluded from this visual draft
details.layout: Mini-ITX enclosure with a conventional rear-panel dual-slot GPU bracket position and compact 1U PSU; no printed GPU support parts, PCIe riser assembly, or riser mounting hardware
details.storage: M.2 only; no separate drive bays
details.ventilation: large perforated side panels; no front ventilation
details.front_panel: solid removable magnetic panel with power-button opening only
details.panel_fit: front, rear, left and right panels extend flush between the top cap and base with no exposed inner-frame gaps
details.perimeter_panel_retention: tool-less magnetic retention for front, left and right panels only; rear panel uses four M3 socket-cap screws into the two rear columns
details.magnet_spec: 10 x 10 x 3 mm square countersunk magnet in a 10.2 x 10.2 x 3.2 mm pocket cut directly into each corner post, retained by one centered M3 countersunk screw; no separate carrier or external frame; four stations each for front, left and right panels, 12 total; no rear-panel magnets
details.rear_panel_mounting: four M3 socket-cap screws, upper and lower on each rear column; rear magnet pockets removed; screws and all mounting features clear motherboard, dual-slot GPU and PSU service apertures
details.psu_mounting: no internal PSU cradle; PSU mounts directly to the rear panel; this visual draft provides the service aperture and mounting face, while model-specific holes are added by the fabricator after PSU selection and are not a current acceptance item

notes: User requires only a conventional dual-slot GPU mounting position in the rear panel. All printed GPU supports and the PSU cradle are removed. The rear panel is fixed to the rear columns with four M3 screws and carries the PSU directly. Model-specific PSU holes are explicitly outside the current visual-draft acceptance scope and are added during fabrication after PSU selection. GPU concept envelope remains 180 x 115 x 40 mm.
